description: The Poros clock tower stands on the pine hill above the neoclassical waterfront, with the narrow strait and the Peloponnese shore beyond. The morning is almost clear, cloud cover about 2 percent, about 21.4°C. The tower is the 1927 landmark on Sphaeria, not a church on the quay.
